name: hybrid-retrieval-smoke
description: Starter labels for the processed corpus. Replace expected_evidence chunk_id values with IDs from your index (see data/evaluation/README.md).

items.question: How does hybrid retrieval combine BM25 and dense vectors?
items.reference_answer: Hybrid retrieval runs BM25 and dense vector search, then fuses ranked lists with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF).

items.question: What metadata is preserved when documents are chunked?
items.reference_answer: Chunks retain page numbers and section metadata for provenance.
